verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents free-trial support: it checks introductory-offer eligibility, and on Apple and Amazon the trial is applied automatically at purchase. It can also grant promotional subscriptions or entitlements through the dashboard or a secret-key API, and webhooks report subscription events. There is no evidence of coupon or promotion-code management, of explicit trial-to-paid conversion handling, or of card-network-compliant trial-end notifications; an older community post (revenuecat-comm-6) even requests trial-expiry reminders as a missing feature. Missing for 10: coupon/promo-code creation and redemption, documented automatic trial-to-paid conversion flow, trial-end reminder notifications meeting card-network rules, independent hands-on corroboration.
